source_cards.citation: Weiss, A. (2026). On the suboptimality of rate–distortion-optimal compression: Fundamental accuracy limits for distributed localization. IEEE Signal Processing Letters, 33, 1566–1570.
source_cards.version_relation: Journal and arXiv share title and author; counted as one study; supplementary theorem proof not obtained
source_cards.read_scope: All main-text sections I–V and references through Zotero PDF text; supplementary material not read
source_cards.observations: x_m(t)=s(t-tau_m(p))+n_m(t); single real WSS Gaussian wideband source, independent WSS Gaussian sensor noise, LOS
source_cards.known: Sensor positions, propagation speed, signal/noise PSDs as model inputs, rate budgets; equal sensor rates/noise in closed-form specialization
source_cards.unknown: Source position; source realization is random/unobserved, not an arbitrary deterministic waveform nuisance vector; no unknown gain/calibration vector included in analyzed parameter set
source_cards.method: Independent per-sensor squared-error RD Gaussian test channels; Whittle spectral Fisher information
anchors: III (6)–(18): RD test channel and asymptotic spectral FI
IV (33)–(43): critical rate and high-band selection counterexample
source_cards.verified_scope_claim: The main text derives a closed-form single-source two-band CRLB and constructs a same-rate high-band-only scheme whose CRLB is lower than reconstruction-RD compression. Merely advocating localization-information-based frequency retention cannot be claimed as new.
source_cards.not_established: This paper does not by itself establish a finite-record multi-source strong/weak deterministic-waveform design, unknown-gain efficient FI, a global rate-allocation optimum, or finite-sample localization RMSE gains.
source_cards.evidence_type: Theoretical analytical bounds plus numerical bound evaluation; not a new localization-estimator Monte Carlo validation

quality.theorem: statement read; supplementary proof not read
quality.real_bit_coder: information-theoretic test-channel model, not implemented codec in this work
quality.source_conflicts: none found in compared title/DOI; no comprehensive retraction/COI audit

source_cards.citation: You, M.-Y., Lu, A.-N., Ye, Y.-X., Huang, K., & Lou, C. (2023). Direct position determination using compressive sensing measurements without reconstruction. IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems, 59(2), 2036–2043.
source_cards.version_relation: Online publication 2022; final issue 2023; one study
source_cards.read_scope: All main-text sections I–VI, Appendices A/B and references through Zotero PDF text
source_cards.observations: Single stationary emitter and stationary time-synchronized receivers; z_l=a_l Q_l s+w_l and y_l=Phi_l z_l
source_cards.known: Receiver positions, propagation speed, compression matrix structure; homogeneous receiver noise in derivation; RSS variant assumes calibrated free-space attenuation structure
source_cards.unknown: Position u, complex amplitudes a_l and deterministic waveform s' (RSS variant ties attenuation ratios to distances)
source_cards.method: Specific Hadamard/block-fold identity preserves reduced time-shift form; eliminate waveform by ML, optimize amplitudes by principal eigenvector; maximize lambda_max(R(u)); RSS-weighted alternative
anchors: III-A (20)–(23): waveform elimination and eigenvalue objective
IV (27)–(39): nuisance-parameter FIM and Schur complement
V: simulated single-source experiment and baselines
source_cards.verified_scope_claim: Compressed-domain reconstruction-free DPD with unknown waveform/gains, and a nuisance-eliminated position CRLB, already exist. Neither adding DPD after compression nor writing a Schur-complement CRLB alone establishes novelty.
source_cards.not_established: The reviewed model/experiments are single-source, synchronized and stationary. The construction is tied to the displayed matrix identity, not a verified guarantee for arbitrary sensor-specific random sketches. Quantization-bit constraints and mixed strong/weak source identification were not formulated in the checked model/method sections.
source_cards.evidence_type: Theory plus reported simulations; this task did not rerun results

quality.formula_extraction: some PDF symbols OCR-damaged; equations are locators, not a checked implementation specification
quality.baseline_fairness: three baselines described in V; independent audit not done
quality.source_conflicts: embedded DOI/title match Zotero; no comprehensive retraction/COI audit
quality.coi: not assessed beyond visible manuscript disclosures

source_cards.citation: Fowler, M. L., Chen, M., Johnson, J. A., & Zhou, Z. (2010). Data compression using SVD and Fisher information for radar emitter location. Signal Processing, 90(7), 2190–2202.
source_cards.version_relation: Author-hosted draft says submitted to IEEE TAES; final publication is Elsevier Signal Processing. Do not treat the draft as an additional independent study.
source_cards.read_scope: All sections 1–5, coding appendix and references through Zotero PDF text
source_cards.observations: Two noisy observations of an unknown noncooperative radar pulse train, related by amplitude/time-delay/Doppler; platforms share compressed reference observations
source_cards.known: Detected/gated pulse boundaries from high-SNR transmitter platform; same-mode deinterleaved subtrain and acquisition sampling; unknown delay/Doppler to estimate
source_cards.unknown: TDOA/FDOA, intercepted waveform; preliminary deinterleaving removes other emitters rather than solving simultaneous mixed-source localization
source_cards.method: Optimize pulse gates, align pulses fractionally, approximate pulse matrix by rank-one SVD, code prototype/amplitudes/side information, optionally remove pulses with lowest time-weighted energy/FDOA information
anchors: 2.1: high-SNR Tx platform and preliminary deinterleaving
3.5 (9)–(12): FI-guided pulse removal and compression ratio
source_cards.verified_scope_claim: FI-based task-aware observation removal, pulse/time-frequency compression and side-information accounting are established prior art, not a novel rationale for a new localization compressor.
source_cards.not_established: High-SNR detected/deinterleaved pulse-train redundancy is a substantive requirement. Results do not directly validate raw inseparable strong/weak continuous-waveform mixtures. Removing pulses for FDOA can hurt TDOA, explicitly reported by authors.
source_cards.evidence_type: Algorithm/theory plus reported pulse-train simulations; no replication here

quality.task_tradeoff: TDOA degradation from pulse removal explicitly retained
quality.metadata_discrepancy: Zotero pages 2191–2202; PDF header and publisher search show 2190–2202; corrected only in this task-derived card

source_cards.citation: Bicer, H. N., & Laneman, J. N. (2026). Spatially distributed task-oriented compression for multi-emitter localization and characterization with spectral overlap (Version 2) [Preprint]. arXiv.
source_cards.version_relation: v1 submitted 2026-05-31, v2 2026-06-04; PDF read is v2; not a peer-reviewed publication claim
source_cards.read_scope: All sections I–VI and references through Zotero PDF text
source_cards.observations: x_i[n]=sum_k sqrt(P_k) alpha_i,k u_k[n]+w_i[n], fixed geometry, distance-dependent amplitude attenuation
source_cards.known: Fixed receiver arrangement/order, path-loss simulation family, known Kmax and waveform-family training distribution
source_cards.unknown: Active K, emitter positions, frequency offsets, bandwidths and waveform families; powers/modulation nuisance variables
source_cards.method: Per-receiver STFT plus receiver-specific neural encoder; concatenate real latent vectors; joint set decoder trained by exact permutation matching with existence/classification/regression loss
anchors: III (7)–(8) and following paragraph: no propagation delays/phase/multipath/shadowing/synchronization impairment
III (9)–(11): latent dimension not explicit bitrate
V-A: fixed receiver geometry and training/test scene generation
V-B and VI: acknowledged geometry/bitrate limitations
source_cards.verified_scope_claim: Distributed learned compression and unordered multi-emitter set estimation with spectral overlap have a concrete prior method; a generic encoder–fusion–set-loss proposal would have close prior art.
source_cards.not_established: The authors explicitly localize via receiver-dependent power only: no modeled TDOA/phase cue. Latents are unquantized and not entropy-coded, so dimension is not communication bitrate. It does not establish unknown-waveform TDOA/DPD preservation under a finite-bit budget.
source_cards.mapping: Transfer only: same distributed IQ-to-compressed-representation-to-emitter-set pipeline, but observation location dependence is amplitude/RSS rather than geometric delay nuisance model
source_cards.evidence_type: Preprint neural simulation study; not a theoretical localization-information guarantee

quality.data_independence: reported train/validation/test scene split; external reproducibility not tested
quality.coi: not assessed beyond visible manuscript disclosures
